visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long, straight black hair stands in a brightly lit room. She is initially seen wearing a brown hand-knitted cable-patterned vest over a grey long-sleeved shirt and pink patterned pajama pants. The background consists of white translucent curtains and a white decorative tree decorated with warm yellow lights. (2) The girl performs a slow 360-degree turn to demonstrate the front and back of the knitted vest. Her expression is neutral but content. The lighting is soft and consistent throughout the space, highlighting the texture of the knitwear. (3) The scene cuts to the girl wearing the same brown vest but with different outfits, including white pants and later purple fuzzy pants. She smiles directly at the camera and poses with her hands on her hips, showing off the garment from various angles. (4) A close-up shot captures the girl's hands as she fastens large, round wooden buttons on the front of a brown knitted cardigan. The intricate cable-knit pattern of the wool is clearly visible. (5) In the final phase, the girl is seen wearing the complete long-sleeved brown cardigan over a purple t-shirt. She poses joyfully, raising her fists in a small celebratory gesture and smiling brightly toward the camera against the same cozy indoor backdrop.
